THE COMPANY

We train the way we fight: operating today with the discipline, process and standards of the company we're building.

Greater Sum Group is a Georgia-based, service-disabled veteran-owned company. Our founders bring decades of combined experience across military service, defense programs, enterprise technology and finance — and one shared belief that the right team is greater than the sum of its parts.
